title: Teach and test the same thinking
statement: Model, practise and test the same thinking step, so every skill a gate tests has been practised before the gate.
detail: A second round of findings on a reading course found the modelled step revealing the answer instead of the thinking, the guided step reduced to a hint, and the independent step sometimes switching to a different skill; one main-idea lesson served an inference item. The adopted rule keeps instruction, practice and assessment on the same cognitive operation, and the reading store's evaluator gap analysis counts coverage as false when an "analyze" standard is assessed by an "identify" item. Label each item with the skill it actually asks for.
against: the same store holds that assessment format is not instruction format, so the form of a task may differ while the thinking step may not.
